svg.title: m8b-stack architecture
svg.desc: One Helm release in one namespace: the M8B Slack bot, the MetricsHub Enterprise agent with its embedded OpenTelemetry Collector, Prometheus and SearXNG, with the bot connecting out to Slack and the LLM endpoint.
svg.text: Helm chart m8b-stack: everything inside the frame is one Helm release in one namespace
